title: GAO federal cybersecurity oversight: January 2022 response review
summary: GAO reported that about 900 federal cybersecurity recommendations remained open as of November 2021. The review focuses on the federal response to the SolarWinds and Microsoft Exchange incidents.
key_findings: GAO reported that about 900 federal cybersecurity recommendations remained open as of November 2021.
Method: GAO synthesis of federal cybersecurity oversight work and recommendation status.
Denominator: The recommendation universe and challenge area stated in each GAO report.
Attribution: Independent federal audit and oversight.
why_it_matters: This observation adds one of three time points for the gao federal cybersecurity oversight series and keeps its unit, denominator, period, geography, method, attribution, and series-break context attached.
ftfn_relevance: Adds one of twelve Phase 56A primary records for institutional AI and cybersecurity system performance.
Supports a within-domain time series without creating a cross-domain score.
Makes revision, denominator, and method limits visible before a direction is described.
evidence_limits: The review focuses on the federal response to the SolarWinds and Microsoft Exchange incidents.
